# AKANARA — Digital Studio in Bali

> Akanara (legal name CV Akanara Digital Solutions) is a founder-led digital
> studio based in Bali, Indonesia, working with clients worldwide. We design and
> build websites, web apps and custom software, and drive growth through SEO,
> performance marketing and branding.

## About

- [Akanara website](https://akanara.com)
- [About the studio](https://akanara.com/about)
- Location: Bali, Indonesia — working worldwide.
- Founder-led; every project is led by a senior design + engineering pair.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://akanara.com/services) — editorial, motion-led, high-performance websites.
- [Web Apps & Custom Software](https://akanara.com/services) — dashboards, platforms, booking and commerce systems.
- [Performance Marketing](https://akanara.com/services) — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and conversion tracking.
- [Branding & Creative Direction](https://akanara.com/services) — identity systems, art direction, guidelines.
- [SEO · SEM · GEO](https://akanara.com/services) — technical SEO, paid search, and generative-engine optimization.

## Selected work

- [Relaxha](https://relaxha.com) — spa & wellness booking web app.
- [Natajiwa Village](https://natajiwa.com) — boutique hospitality website in Kerobokan, Bali.
- [Kintamani Dirt Bike Adventure](https://kintamanidirtbikeadventure.com) — tour operator website.
- [Maguska Tour](https://maguskatour.com) — Bali travel & tours website.
- [Rarama Living Studio](https://raramalivingstudio.com) — hotel & stay website, Bali.
- [Akalink](https://akalink.id) — custom web application.
